scope: Candidate selection, not vulnerability applicability or acceptance
trixie: Not selected for security remediation: only tzdata updated; 164 findings and 44 High remain.
bookworm: Not adopted: 243 findings remain, including 59 High; scanner counts alone do not establish a safer supported runtime.
next: Move to package/binary-specific applicability and minimal-runtime design for Python OS findings; separately remediate PostgreSQL/embedded Go/Alpine images. Do not repeat unchanged base refreshes as remediation.

source_notes.note: Debian lists bookworm/trixie util-linux vulnerable; sid/forky fixed. Trixie no-dsa minor issue. Runtime-specific applicability has not been decided.
Debian lists stable ACL packages vulnerable, fixes in sid/forky; notes ABI changes and deferred stable updates. No individual advisory waived.
